Every lead time, staff effort, external party waited on, multiplicity and resource capacity is a PROVISIONAL ASSUMPTION (config/assumptions.yaml: value, basis, owner); none is stated in the tender pack. Earliest dates come from a forward pass from the planning date (the latest addendum's issue date), latest dates from a backward pass in Working Days (VOL-I 2.4) from the pack's dates; negative float is INFEASIBLE, never compressed. Timing, decision readiness and resource feasibility are separate statuses; resource levelling is NOT implemented; overloads are reported, not resolved. No bidder references, certificates, attendance or financial standing are assumed to exist.
planning_basis: Planning date 2026-10-22 = the issue date of ADD-02, the latest addendum at this stage (owner's instruction: the latest addendum date is the planning date). Earliest dates: a forward pass in Working Days (VOL-I 2.4: Sunday to Thursday, declared holidays excluded; holidays configured: none) from the first Working Day on or after the planning date (2026-10-22). Latest dates: a backward pass from the pack deadlines in force at ADD-02 (ATTENDANCE-NOTICE 2026-10-14; CLARIFICATION-CUTOFF 2026-11-12; PDD 2026-11-26 14:00). Total float = Working Days from earliest start to latest start; negative float = INFEASIBLE by that many Working Days (never compressed). Proposal Due Date at this stage: 2026-11-26.
purpose: HYPOTHETICAL declared public holidays inside the bid window (Sun 15 to Wed 18 November 2026, four Working Days, about the length of an Eid break); the pack declares none and no real holiday is claimed for these dates.

rows.name: Complete the Financial Model (unlocked, fully formula-linked Excel, no macros, no hard-coded values in calculation cells), reflecting ADD-03 Section 3: Base Date pricing, and indexation with a Bidder-chosen Indexed Proportion within the band of the replaced VOL-V 29.2; the price basis follows the decision on I-ADD03-PRICE-BASIS
Appoint the independent model auditor (opinion to be addressed to the Authority)
Agree the Parent Company Guarantee wording (substantially Form 4-D; unconditional for the construction period) with the EPC Contractor's ultimate parent

Write the Technical Proposal narrative (process design to the effective TN limit including the membrane filtration step of nominal pore size not exceeding 0.1 µm (VOL-II 3.1 as amended); construction methodology with a crane and lifting plan demonstrating compliance with Table 5-1 (ADD-03 Q21); standby power duration; page limit as amended)
Review the data-room geotechnical report and satisfy the Bidder as to ground conditions (e.g. the wadi crossing; ADD-01 Q4); feed the construction methodology and the price
Obtain indicative financing terms (debt tenor, margin, gearing) for the model
Obtain the client completion certificate for each reference project (a reference without one is disregarded, VOL-I 9.5)
Rolling review of the draft Financial Model by the model auditor
Obtain the board resolutions of each member authorising its signatories
Collect commercial-operation evidence for the reference plants (capacity, commercial operation within the look-back window)
Obtain bank approval for the Bid Bond
Review Volume V and list every deviation, qualification or reservation, including every assumption in any part of the Proposal that limits or qualifies a Volume V obligation (ADD-03 Q16)
Obtain evidence of the O&M Operator's continuous operation of a qualifying facility (VOL-I 8.8)
Obtain the executed Parent Company Guarantee from the ultimate parent
Notarise the Power of Attorney of each signatory (Form 4-A signatory of the lead member; Form 4-C signatory of each member)
Submit clarification requests citing Volume, Clause and page (e.g. Form 4-A printed date; Envelope B contents; one USB per envelope)
Collect each member's most recent audited financial statements (three financial years)
Freeze the Financial Model (final inputs and version) for the audit opinion and Form 4-F
Review the six Form 4-G undertakings with the O&M and OT security leads
Prepare Form 4-C in Arabic for each member
For each foreign member: evidence of a current investment licence, or a signed undertaking to obtain it before Financial Close (VOL-I 8.9)
Audit of the frozen Financial Model and issue of the opinion addressed to the Authority (VOL-I 10.3)
Prepare one Form 4-B for each reference project from the reference evidence, every printed field drafted (preparation; not gated)
Issue the Bid Bond (validity per VOL-I 6.3)
Compute and evidence combined tangible net worth and three-year average turnover, weighted by shareholding (VOL-I 8.4)
Sign and stamp Form 4-C at each member (Arabic governs; a translation may be attached)
Prepare the schedule of principal financing assumptions to accompany Form 4-F (VOL-I 10.6)
Prepare Form 4-A on the version reissued by ADD-01 Appendix A: Bidder and lead member, Addenda acknowledged, single point of contact (preparation; not gated)

Finalise and sign Form 4-E; check that no qualification appears elsewhere in the Proposal, treating any assumption that limits a Volume V obligation as a qualification, and that a 'no deviations' statement is not undercut by assumptions in the Technical Proposal (VOL-I 9.6; ADD-03 Q16)

Complete and sign Form 4-F from the frozen Financial Model (single Availability Payment, SAR per annum, excluding VAT); in the row 'Indexation basis assumed' state, after 'Per Volume V Clause 29.2', the Indexed Proportion as a percentage within the range set by the replacement Clause 29.2(a) (ADD-03 Q20, 3.3)

Obtain a copy of the EPC Contractor's ISO 9001:2015 certificate (where the EPC Contractor is an unincorporated JV, a copy of each member's certificate, each meeting VOL-I 8.3, per ADD-03 Q17) and check each is current at the PDD
Confirm the single point of contact to be named in Form 4-A; notify any later change within 2 Working Days (VOL-I 4.3)
Finalise Form 4-A (which form version and fields, and how its stale printed Proposal Due Date is corrected, as decided on I-F4A-FIELDS) and sign by the lead member's PoA holder

Finalise each Form 4-B: the 'Contract value (SAR equivalent)' field is kept (not deleted or relocated) and completed as the decision on I-VOL-I-ENV-A-PRICES directs (VOL-I 6.2: no commercial information in Envelope A)
Complete and sign Form 4-G
